name: SUB ZERO Festival
blurb: Event website for SUB ZERO 2026, twelve nights of electronic music and visual art at the Biltmore Cabaret.

detail.business: SUB ZERO is a twelve-night electronic music and visual art festival at the Biltmore Cabaret in Vancouver. It needed a striking event website for its lineup, schedule and tickets.
detail.built: Built in Webflow from the festival's own brand artwork, with icy custom typography, a frost-framed hero and a page for every night of the festival. Tuned for speed on phones and launched on its own domain.
detail.notable: Every show night has its own page with set times and visual artists, linked from a schedule built around the official event posters, with a festival pass and single-night tickets one click away.

SUB ZERO Festival on three phone screens

eventNote: SUB ZERO was a limited-run event website, built for the 2026 festival at the Biltmore Cabaret and kept online only while the festival ran (December 3 to 20, 2026). That is why there is no live link. The images on this page show the site exactly as it ran.

name: The Yale Saloon
blurb: Complete redesign of the official website for Vancouver's home for all things country.

detail.business: The Yale Saloon is Vancouver's country bar on Granville Street, home to line dancing and bull riding. Its old website didn't capture the energy of the venue, so I redesigned it from the ground up.
detail.built: Designed and built in Webflow with a custom Western identity: rope photo frames, hand-drawn decor, ticket-style buttons, a video hero and a book-matched wood texture, all tuned for fast loading on phones.
detail.notable: A live events calendar connected to the ticketing system, group bookings straight into the events team, photo submissions and a menu, all meeting WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility.

name: Wildflower Line Dancing
blurb: Lessons and events site for a line dancing company in Greater Vancouver.

detail.business: Wildflower Line Dancing is a Vancouver line dancing company run by instructors Alex and Lily. They needed a fun, welcoming site that made booking lessons and events easy.
detail.built: Built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, deployed on Vercel. A warm cream and blush palette with Western-inspired headings, a split photo hero and service artwork designed with the client.
detail.notable: Every service has its own booking form that sends enquiries straight to the team's inbox, plus a dedicated event page for their Halloween line dancing competition at The Yale Saloon.

name: Coach Pavle
blurb: High-impact personal brand site for an MMA coach in Vancouver.

detail.business: Coach Pavle is a professional MMA coach based in Vancouver, BC, coaching 1-on-1 in person and online. He needed a site that commanded respect, reflected his coaching philosophy, and converted visitors into serious athletes.
detail.built: Built with Next.js and hand-written CSS, deployed on Vercel. Dark, bold design with a strong typographic hierarchy that matches the intensity of the sport.
detail.notable: The site establishes Coach Pavle's personal brand with zero fluff. Every section is designed to build credibility and drive enquiries from athletes ready to commit.

name: Rocha Academy of Jiu-Jitsu
blurb: Safe, structured kids jiu-jitsu classes across Coquitlam and North Vancouver.

detail.business: Rocha Academy of Jiu-Jitsu runs kids Brazilian jiu-jitsu programs across Coquitlam and North Vancouver. The site needed to reassure parents first, then make it easy to find the right class and get started.
detail.built: Built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, deployed on Vercel. An olive and tan palette, a friendly hedgehog mascot, and clear program pages split by age group and location.
detail.notable: The whole site is written for parents rather than athletes, leading with safety, structure, and confidence-building before technique.

name: Beach Haven Cafe
blurb: Brand identity and logo suite for a beachside cafe in South Australia.

detail.business: Beach Haven Cafe is a beloved beachside cafe in South Australia. We developed a full brand identity suite to capture their relaxed coastal character across all touchpoints.
detail.built: Delivered a complete logo suite including a circular badge logo, wordmark, and alternate colorways for use across print, digital, and merchandise.
detail.notable: Four logo variants (full color, green wordmark, black, and white) give the cafe flexibility across light and dark backgrounds, uniforms, signage, and packaging.

name: Dublin Calling
blurb: Multi-location pub and kitchen site serving three venues across Canada.
mockupBlurb: a multi-location pub and kitchen with three venues across Canada

detail.business: Dublin Calling is a party pub and kitchen with three locations in Toronto (Adelaide St and Danforth Ave) and Vancouver (Granville St). One brand, three distinct venues, each needing their own content.
detail.built: Built with Next.js 16 App Router and Tailwind CSS. Single codebase with dynamic location routing so each venue gets its own pages, menus, events, and contact details.
detail.notable: Three fully independent venue experiences under one domain: menus, events, group bookings, and FAQs all managed per location without duplicating the codebase.

name: Lions MMA
blurb: Full rebuild for one of Vancouver's most established MMA gyms.
mockupBlurb: one of Vancouver's most established MMA and combat sports gyms

detail.business: Lions MMA is a 25-year-old MMA gym in Vancouver, BC with a serious competition pedigree. Their old generic template site did nothing to reflect their history or convert new members.
detail.built: Full rebuild in Astro with React islands, Tailwind CSS v4, and Vercel. Warm near-black palette with brass accents, a filterable class schedule, 9 individual program pages, and a blog.
detail.notable: A signature tale-of-the-tape design motif runs throughout the site as a nod to the sport's tradition, giving the brand a distinctive visual identity no template could replicate.
